inside: ReleaseApplicationView stable selection and list-query events
environment: existing release page status and artifact filters
dirty rokey worktree changes outside the task write scope

state_variables.name: main_list_query
valid_values: exact selected record plus other filters

causal_paths.input: user focuses, types into, selects from or clears one of the four list search controls
transitions: view maps real records to one option contract
outputs: consistent selection-only fuzzy search interaction on all four pages

causal_paths.input: empty focus or case-insensitive code, name or version fragment
transitions: local provider performs substring matching or remote provider queries existing API
outputs: at most 20 scoped matching options in existing source order

causal_paths.input: temporary text, real option selection or clear action
transitions: temporary text remains internal to selector
outputs: main list changes only for selection or clear and remains governed by other filters

causal_paths.input: current project/window data or remote application query
transitions: local views map complete loaded arrays
application provider debounces project-scoped API call
outputs: scope-correct candidates without stale project or window selections

causal_paths.input: candidate loading, no match, failure or long candidate text
transitions: failure remains isolated from main-list state
module CSS constrains primary and secondary text
outputs: recoverable and readable toolbar/dropdown state with a valid production build

interfaces.name: ReleaseSearchSelect props and events
interfaces.invariant: update:modelValue is emitted only for a real option selection or clear; search carries temporary text separately

interfaces.name: ReleaseSearchOption
producers: release types and four option mappers
interfaces.invariant: value is stable and label, description and keywords are derived from the same real scoped record

interfaces.name: listReleaseApplications
producers: existing release API module and backend
interfaces.invariant: candidate requests use independent loading/error/results and fixed page 1 size 20 without mutating main-list pagination

sensors.target: shared component and all call-site contracts
sensors.method: npx vue-tsc --noEmit and npm run build
blind_spots: runtime focus, blur and dropdown behavior

sensors.target: absence of legacy free-text list search controls and unauthorized changes
sensors.method: targeted rg, git diff and git diff --check

sensors.target: focus, fuzzy typing, selection, clear, blur and scope invalidation on all four pages
sensors.method: authenticated browser interaction at /release with row and option observations
blind_spots: rare network races not induced during the run

sensors.target: application candidate/main-list request separation and stale-response suppression
sensors.method: browser network and UI observations during rapid application search input
blind_spots: backend behavior outside the exercised project

replace keyword state with real selected IDs and record-derived option mappings
actuators.authority: write access to the three release view files
actuators.impact_radius: window, baseline and current-production list toolbars
actuators.rollback: restore each view's prior keyword ref and computed includes filter

actuators.action: add debounced candidate state/provider and route only selected application code into the existing list query
actuators.authority: write access to ReleaseApplicationView and ReleaseManagementPrototype
actuators.rollback: restore the existing keyword watcher and remove candidate state

actuators.action: include subsystem_code in the existing parameterized keyword predicate and add a focused persistence contract test
actuators.authority: write access to server/src/modules/release under the ready release-management requirement
actuators.impact_radius: release application list keyword matching only
actuators.rollback: remove the additional OR predicate and focused test assertion

disturbances.effect: previous selection or candidates may become invalid
older application candidates could overwrite newer results
diff or build failures may have pre-existing causes

delays.source: 300ms application candidate debounce plus network latency
delays.consequence: candidate results arrive after temporary input changes
delays.sampling_rule: observe only the latest generation after debounce and response completion

delays.consequence: immediate DOM counts may precede selection update
delays.sampling_rule: wait for the next rendered stable state before comparing rows

assumptions.text: window, baseline and current-production arrays are complete for their current scope
assumptions.evidence: their existing implementations already perform all keyword filtering locally; windows are explicitly loaded with size 200 and the other APIs return arrays
assumptions.falsifier: runtime responses report truncation or pagination beyond loaded arrays

assumptions.text: applicationCode is a stable unique value for exact application selection
assumptions.evidence: existing row key, detail route and API path all use applicationCode
assumptions.falsifier: one tenant returns duplicate application codes

assumptions.text: Element Plus el-select does not commit arbitrary filter text as modelValue without allow-create
assumptions.evidence: the component's model values originate from el-option and existing code uses the same library behavior
assumptions.falsifier: browser verification observes unlisted text in modelValue

control_assessment.action: implement shared selector and four integrations
limit local and remote options to 20 and verify fragments
separate temporary input from stable selected values
use complete local sources and generation-guarded remote candidates
add explicit candidate states and constrained module styling
